historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 8.7% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr 3.8% and EPS 3yr -8.1%. Equity growth is retained underlying profit at ~50% payout, not top-line growth; reported EPS is distorted by the FY2025 RMB2.9bn baijiu goodwill impairment (underlying EPS 3yr CAGR ~9.6%). Revenue 5yr includes the FY2023 Jinsha baijiu acquisition. Revenue 3yr CAGR (2.5%) selected as the organic proxy.
historical_growth.notes: SBC is zero and interest income sits outside OCF, so owner FCF = reported FCF and the CAGRs are unadjusted (FCF here OCF - capex, before ~90/yr lease cash). FCF 3yr is depressed by the FY2023 working-capital and capex year; FCF FY2020 3,433 -> FY2025 5,328.

scenario_narratives.base: China beer is a volume-flat, mix-up market and CR Beer keeps winning the mix: sub-premium and above (Heineken, Lao Xue, Amstel, new Snow Gold Crown) grows high single digits while mainstream Snow volume erodes, giving ~2% revenue growth. Margins extend modestly from FY2025's 25.9% to 27.5% on mix and lean operations (brewery closures, procurement), not on a repeat of the 2024-25 barley and aluminium windfall. Baijiu stays a small, low-margin drag (post-impairment EBITDA ~1.5% of group) rather than a second growth engine. Cash conversion stays high and the ~50-55% payout continues.
scenario_narratives.bull: Premiumisation accelerates: the sub-premium share passes a third of volume, Heineken keeps compounding ~20%, the Greater Bay Area/export push and contract brewing add volume, and the beer industry consolidates further around the top two. Revenue grows 3-4% and EBITDA margin converges toward the 29-30% that Budweiser APAC's China premium book earns. Baijiu stabilises as the cycle turns and stops consuming management attention.
scenario_narratives.bear: Chinese consumption stays deflationary and beer follows Japan's path: volume declines 2-3% a year with ageing and moderation, the on-trade weakens, and Tsingtao, Budweiser APAC and Yanjing fight for the premium tier with promotions. Barley and aluminium costs revert, so the 2023-25 margin gains largely unwind toward ~22% (the FY2022 underlying level was ~21%). Baijiu needs further write-downs and capital. Revenue shrinks for three years, capex stays elevated for intelligent-brewery upgrades, and the business is capitalised at 10x with zero terminal growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A cash-generative, net-cash, SOE-controlled national brewer valued on owner FCF in CNY, converted to HKD for comparison with the HKEX quote. No SBC, so house and street bases coincide. The price (~9x underlying earnings, ~6% dividend yield) sits near the bear case: the market is discounting a Japan-style volume decline and margin reversal, or applying a discount rate well above an 8.5% CNY cost of equity. The required-return table shows what IRR today's price implies.
key_risks_to_valuation: Discount rate: at 8.5% in CNY the model credits terminal value the HK market currently refuses China consumer stocks; the required-return table is the honest read of the gap.
Margin reversal: FY2025's 25.9% underlying EBITDA margin includes raw-material savings that can reverse.
Beer volume: structural decline from demographics and moderation; premiumisation must outrun it.
Baijiu: RMB2.9bn goodwill already impaired; management's sensitivity shows a further 648m impairment on modest assumption changes; NCI carried at book.
Bridge timing: the H1-26 FCF and two dividends removed from the 30-Jun cash; an error here moves value ~RMB 0.5-1.8/share.
FX: CNY/HKD rate is a dated input that refresh_price.py does not move.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HKD 17.87-29.10. RMB counter 80291.HK used for the FX parity check.
data_sources.financials: 0291.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2018-FY2025, H1 2024-2026, RMB millions); FY2025 Annual Report (segment note, cash flow statement, notes 18/28/30B, MD&A underlying EBITDA 9,879 and profit 5,724); 2026 Interim Report (balance sheet, cash flow, notes 10 and 13, chairman's statement).

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,244.18m shares in issue, unchanged FY2018-H1 2026; no effective share scheme at 31-Dec-2025 (FY2025 AR, Share Options Scheme section), so basic = fully diluted. Held flat: no SBC, no buybacks, no non-SBC issuance.
inputs.cash_composition: 30-Jun-2026 interim balance sheet: cash and equivalents 13,976 + restricted 236 + pledged 18 + bank wealth-management products 3,634 (current FVTPL 3,893 less the 259 current portion of the Shenzhen relocation receivable, note 10). Debt = unsecured RMB bank loans 3,873 short + 1,335 long (note 13). Loan from joint venture (600 at Dec-25) fully repaid in H1 2026. Lease liabilities (84) excluded: treatment (B).
inputs.reported_fcf_definition: FY2025 OCF 7,127 - purchase of fixed assets 1,799 - lease principal 83 - lease interest 6 (treatment B). Interest received (347) is classified in investing, so OCF already excludes interest income; no further deduction.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income 107 sits below segment EBITDA and its cash receipt is in investing activities; neither the FCF base nor the projected segment-EBITDA margin contains it, so 0 is deducted and the cash it earns on is in the bridge once.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR: 'The Company did not have any effective share scheme as at 31 December 2025'; no share-based payment expense in the FY2025 cash flow reconciliation. SBC-zero market: house and street coincide.
inputs.fx_note: 1 CNY = 1.1721 HKD, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10T03:38Z. Parity check against the RMB counter 80291.HK: CNY 16.28 x 1.1721 = HKD 19.08 vs 0291.HK HKD 19.13 (0.3% tie), which confirms rate, direction and quote basis. The interim report converted its dividend at 1.15587 (Aug-2026); refresh_price.py does not move this rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' own currency: China 10y government bond ~1.9% + beta 1.0 x 6.5% China ERP (mature-market ERP plus country premium) = 8.4%, rounded to 8.5%. Net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 8.5% on all three scenarios: China consumption, beer-volume and baijiu risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): lease cash (principal 83 + interest 6 = 89 in FY2025, 0.23% of revenue) charged inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path 0.25%; lease liabilities (84 at 30-Jun-2026) excluded from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100% of Guizhou Jinsha baijiu, 55.19% owned). NCI charged once, in the bridge, at book 3,603 (30-Jun-2026). Book is conservative: post-impairment baijiu EBITDA is only ~1.5% of group (FY2025 264; Jinsha 140), so the 45% minority's economic claim is likely nearer RMB 0.7-1.5bn; at 1.0bn the value per share rises ~RMB 0.80. Book is kept because it is what management's post-impairment value-in-use test supports.
inputs.da_note: da_pct is DEDUCTIBLE depreciation only (~4.4% of revenue: FY2025 D&A 2,398 less amortisation of acquired intangibles 728). The Jinsha brand/customer amortisation is a consolidation fair-value uplift with no tax shield, so it is excluded from the tax base; D&A is added back in the flows either way.
inputs.calibration: FY0 check: underlying segment EBITDA 9,833 (beer 9,611 ex JV-relocation income 260 and capacity-optimisation charges 306; baijiu 264 ex 2,877 goodwill impairment; corporate -42) = 25.9% margin. (9,833 - 1,670 depreciation) x 75% = 6,122 NOPAT; less after-tax intangible amortisation ~546, plus after-tax interest ~80 = ~5,656 vs reported underlying attributable profit 5,724 (1.2% gap; NCI share of baijiu ~nil). Year-1 owner FCF ~5.9bn vs H1-2026 actual 5,942 with H2 seasonally ~nil (FY2025 H2 ~-100, FY2024 H2 ~-440).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, with the non-US adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, lease treatment B, NCI in bridge, matching-asset rule, SBC-zero). Route: operating consumer-staples brewer (China's largest by volume, Snow + Heineken China brands) with a small loss-impaired baijiu arm; no bank/REIT/holdco features. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry, no prior DCF). BRIDGE TIMING: valued off the 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet, but year 1 is FY2026 in full, so the H1-2026 owner FCF already sitting in that cash (5,942) is removed in the equity bridge to avoid counting it twice; the FY2025 final dividend (RMB0.557, paid ~8-Jul-2026) and FY2026 interim (RMB0.446, record date 3-Sep-2026, paid 21-Oct-2026) are also deducted because today's buyer has no claim on them. June cash is seasonally high (beer peak season, promotional liabilities); the adjusted figure reconciles to the Dec-2025 net cash plus the relocation receivable. Year-1 is discounted a full year although only ~2.5 months of FY2026 remain - a small conservatism. ONE-OFFS EXCLUDED from the base: FY2025 JV-relocation income ~1,005, baijiu goodwill impairment 2,877, capacity-optimisation charges 306. No buybacks: the flat count is a convention the company does not need to fund (no SBC). Dividend payout ~53% of underlying profit (FY2025 DPS RMB1.021).

base.growth_rationale: FY2026: H1 turnover +1.2% (beer +2.2%, baijiu down), H2 similar. Then ~2-2.5%: flat-to-declining China beer volume (FY2025 +1.4%, H1-26 +1.7%) plus ~1-1.5% mix/ASP from sub-premium (now >26% of volume, +10% in H1-26). Fades to 2.0%; terminal 1.5% nominal in a ~1-2% inflation RMB economy.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 underlying 25.9% (from ~23.3% FY2024) on premiumisation, barley/packaging savings and brewery closures (4 shut in 2025, 59 left). +0.3pp/yr to 27.5% as mix keeps lifting gross margin (beer GM 42.5%, +1.4pp) and opex ratio falls; stops well short of Budweiser APAC-style ~30%.
base.capex_rationale: 5.2% of revenue: FY2021-25 average 5.5% (4.4/4.7/6.5/7.3/4.7), capacity optimisation largely done; H1-26 758 is the lowest half in years. Deductible depreciation 4.5%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: Chinese consumer deflation is current, beer volume is structurally flat-to-down, and the FY2025 margin step-up owes part of itself to input-cost tailwinds that can reverse. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs volume growth, sustained premium-mix gains and a margin level only the foreign premium specialist has reached, all at once. Base 50% as the continuation of the observed 2023-H1 2026 trajectory.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
